title: Modal editor
description: Modal editor (`.monaco-modal-editor-block.compact-header`): the dimmed backdrop, a centered resizable rounded panel with a 40px compact header (title + muted description, Maximize and Close actions) and one editor group whose editor fills the rest. This is how the Agents window shows Customizations by default (`workbench.editor.useModal: some`).
usage: Wrap an editor that opens modally (Customizations, Settings in the Agents window). Use `contained` inside a positioned mock window so the backdrop covers only that window. Listen for `modal-close` / `modal-maximize`.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Muted text after the title, e.g. "(Copilot · scratchpad)".

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Codicon for the title label (hidden in the compact header).

attributes.name: contained
attributes.description: Fill the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport (for previews/prototypes).

states.name: open
states.trigger: Shown while present; Close / backdrop click fire `modal-close`.

examples.title: Customizations modal
examples.html: <vsc-workbench window="agents" theme="dark-2026" style="position: relative; width: 1152px; height: 685px;"><vsc-modal-editor contained heading="Customizations" description="(Copilot · scratchpad)" width="1152" height="684.8"><vsc-customizations-editor section="skills" style="height: 100%;"></vsc-customizations-editor></vsc-modal-editor></vsc-workbench>
